## Changes
- **Launch to a moon in one plan.** LAUNCH has a new **THEN** row: *Stay in orbit*, a flyby of a moon, or an orbit of a moon, with **PERIAPSIS AT MOON** below it (100 km by default). With a moon picked and no target, LAUNCH sets the launch plane and the launch window for the moon. After the ascent, AFC plans the injection burn, checks the course as flown, plans up to two small correction burns, and for an orbit plans the capture burn at the periapsis. Stock AUTO flies each burn, and AFC warps to it. A burn that you plan, a chain burn that you change or remove, or AUTO switched off stops the chain and leaves everything as it is. Launch-plane geometry by cairn5. ([#146](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/146))
- **Softer landings with touchdown guidance.** DEORBIT + LAND and LAND NOW keep flying when the touchdown plan is lost, instead of cutting the engine in the air. The plan now ends where the first point of the craft meets the ground, so a craft that cannot hover touches down at about 1 m/s or less. After touchdown the attitude stays in **MANUAL**, so the RCS no longer pushes a landed craft. The solver table on LAND shows only **TOUCHDOWN**, and AFC refuses before the deorbit burn when no landing guidance can fly the craft, with the reason. ([#148](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/148))
- **Flybys that arrive where you asked.** The flyby preview on TRANSFER now shows the burn that **CREATE** makes, and **CREATE** refuses a flyby that has no solution and says why. After a flyby departure to a moon, AFC checks the flown course and adds up to two small correction burns when the periapsis is off by more than 10 percent. They stay in Manual, and you fly them with **FLY BURN**. ([#144](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/144))
- **LAUNCH checks before it starts.** The gravity turn refuses a plane that the launch site cannot reach and names the nearest inclination that it can reach. A launch into a target plane outside its launch window is refused with the time of the next window. New **REACH** and **TWR** rows show the cost of the plane change and warn when the first stage cannot lift off. An ascent that runs out of propellant before cutoff now says so and gives the orbit it reached. ([#142](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/142))
- **1x while AFC plans.** At a high simulation speed, LAUNCH failed with "SOLVED PLAN DOES NOT FIT LAUNCH" and DEORBIT + LAND waited. AFC now holds 1x while it solves a launch plan or plans a deorbit burn, and then gives your speed back. ([#140](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/140))
- **Launcher instances.** AFC reads and writes its files (staging delays, multi-pass plans, RCS options and logs) in the profile folder that the game runs in, so a game started from a launcher with its own profile keeps its own AFC settings. ([#138](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/138))

## Known limits
- A craft that cannot hover can tip over after touchdown on a slope of 10 degrees or more.
- An automatic entry from orbit on a body with air is refused.
- A flown burn can miss more at high time warp. The course correction covers this for a flyby and for a launch to a moon.

AFC needs StarMap and no other mod.
